clue.text: Drive needs confidence about the first quarter of an hour

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so the word for confidence wraps round the letter taken

parts.note: confidence in someone is trust

indicators.note: hour has four letters, so its first quarter is just its opening letter

explanation.surface: A motorist needs self-belief for the opening fifteen minutes of a drive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts TRUST round H, the first of the four letters of 'hour'.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrust is a forceful push or drive, as in the drive of an argument.

clue.text: Look at article and boil furiously

parts.note: to look at something is to see it
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Glance at a newspaper piece and get furious.
explanation.definitionFit: To seethe is literally to bubble at the boil, and figuratively to fume with anger.

clue.text: Unexceptional landlord gets communication with no subscription

parts.note: something unexceptional is nondescript, without distinguishing features: anonymous
a landlord lets property, so is a letter

explanation.surface: An ordinary landlord receives a note that nobody signed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'subscription' is used in its old sense of a signature written beneath a document.
explanation.definitionFit: An unsigned note or message bears no signature, and 'subscription' once meant a name written at the foot of a page.

clue.text: Make a brief call to strikers who are thinking of going back

definitions.meaning: to break a journey with a short visit somewhere

definitions.text: strikers who are thinking of going back
definitions.meaning: workers on strike considering returning might say their stoppage is called off

explanation.definitionFit: To pause briefly on a journey is to break it with a short visit; for strikers, the strike (a stop) would be off.

clue.text: Voice no complaint

parts.note: someone who never voices a grievance bears hardship quietly

explanation.definitionFit: Bearing pain or hardship without a word is the same as never voicing a grievance.

clue.text: Very appreciative for as much coal as the fire can carry

definitions.meaning: deeply thankful

definitions.text: as much coal as the fire can carry
definitions.meaning: read whimsically as a fireplace grate filled to capacity

explanation.definitionFit: Deeply thankful is the plain sense; split, the word suggests a fireplace grid loaded to the brim with coal.

clue.text: A nib con involved with a challenge to Shakespeare

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so these letters are jumbled together

explanation.surface: A pen-wielding con man is mixed up in a plot questioning the Bard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' rearranges A NIB CON together with the second 'a' into BACONIAN.
explanation.definitionFit: The Baconian theory holds that Francis Bacon, not Shakespeare, wrote the plays, so it challenges Shakespeare's authorship.

clue.text: Motoring enthusiast must have a screw loose if it comes off

definitions.text: Motoring enthusiast must have a screw loose if it comes off

parts.words: Motoring enthusiast must have a screw loose if it comes off
parts.note: a fanatic about cars is a nut for the steering device; a fastener holding a car's road wheel, if it falls off, leaves things loose

explanation.definitionFit: The fastener securing a road wheel is a threaded piece; nut also means a fan, and having a screw loose means being crazy.

clue.text: A French and Spanish coin which cannot be genuine

parts.note: un is French for a
the real was an old Spanish silver coin

explanation.surface: A coin from France and Spain must surely be counterfeit.
explanation.definitionFit: Something imaginary or fake cannot be genuine.

clue.text: The horses have started but the riders have fallen

definitions.meaning: a race commentator's call when a race begins: they are away
jockeys who have fallen have come ... their mounts

explanation.definitionFit: Racing commentary says the field is away when it starts; a rider who falls has come away from the saddle.

clue.text: Conclude negotiations in preparation for the wintry blast

definitions.meaning: to settle a deal finally

definitions.text: in preparation for the wintry blast
definitions.meaning: fastening a coat fully against the cold

explanation.definitionFit: To finalise a deal is to tie it up; one fastens a coat completely against cold wind.

clue.text: Six feet sound

definitions.meaning: a nautical unit of depth measuring six feet
to sound is to measure the depth of water, or to get to the bottom of something

explanation.definitionFit: A unit of depth of six feet; as a verb, measuring water depth or understanding something thoroughly.

clue.text: Busy canal running along a busy highway

definitions.text: Busy canal running along a busy highway

parts.words: Busy canal running along a busy highway
parts.note: the watery picture describes a continuous flow of vehicles along a road

explanation.definitionFit: A continuous flow of vehicles is likened to running water along a channel.

clue.text: High-grade paper pulp used for cheap paper

definitions.meaning: fine paper is made from cloth fibre pulp
a low-quality newspaper

explanation.definitionFit: Quality writing paper is made from cloth fibre; a trashy tabloid newspaper is also so called.

clue.text: Have a cigarette and become more cheerful

definitions.meaning: to ignite a cigarette and start smoking
a face brightens when its owner cheers up

explanation.definitionFit: Lighting a smoke is one sense; a face brightening with happiness is the other.

clue.text: Merchant claiming to be a carrier of goods

parts.note: someone claiming an identity says 'I am', shortened to I'm
a porter carries luggage and goods

explanation.surface: A trader insists he is just a humble baggage handler.
explanation.definitionFit: A trader who brings goods in from abroad is a kind of merchant.

clue.text: Working strenuously when that raid went wrong

indicators.note: a raid that went wrong falls apart, so its letters are disordered

explanation.surface: The gang were sweating away when that robbery failed.
explanation.definitionFit: To be hard at something is an idiom for working with great effort.

clue.text: Amusing oneself with a line and theodolite

definitions.meaning: fishing with rod and line as a hobby
a surveyor's instrument for measuring angles, so whimsically what one does with it

explanation.definitionFit: Fishing with a rod and line is the hobby; a surveying instrument is used for measuring angles.

clue.text: Gershwin is responsible for acts of terrorism

definitions.meaning: ... Gershwin was the lyricist brother of George
the Irish Republican Army, a paramilitary group

explanation.definitionFit: The lyricist brother of George Gershwin shares his name with the initials of the Irish Republican Army.

clue.text: Cork traffic cop?

definitions.meaning: a bung for a bottle
playfully, a police officer who halts vehicles

explanation.definitionFit: A bung for a bottle; and, whimsically, someone who halts cars.

clue.text: Mounting it will result in your going round in circles

definitions.text: Mounting it will result in your going round in circles

parts.words: Mounting it will result in your going round in circles
parts.note: climbing a winding set of steps takes you round and round

explanation.definitionFit: A helical flight of steps turns continuously, so climbing it carries you round in circles.

clue.text: Birthday honour recipient in vehicle seen on the road

indicators.note: in places the honour holder inside the vehicle

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
an MBE (Member of the Order of the British Empire) is often awarded in the King's Birthday Honours

explanation.surface: A newly decorated dignitary rides past in a car.
explanation.walkthrough: The Birthday Honours is a twice-yearly British list of royal awards; MBE is a common one.
explanation.definitionFit: The slight upward curve of a road surface, letting water drain off, is visible on any road.

clue.text: One who finds the answer to lovers' enigma

indicators.note: an enigma is a puzzle, so the letters are in a puzzling order to be worked out

explanation.surface: Someone cracks the mystery of two lovers.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who works out puzzles is described, like the person doing this crossword.

clue.text: Being likely to stray, first hesitate then go on and on

parts.note: er is the sound made when hesitating
to rant is to talk at length, loudly

explanation.surface: A wanderer pauses before launching into a long tirade.
explanation.definitionFit: Errant means wandering or going astray from the proper course.

clue.text: Reconnoitre on foot leads to an introduction

definitions.meaning: whimsically, to take a stroll beforehand to scout ahead
an opening statement before the main text

explanation.definitionFit: Read as a stroll taken beforehand, the word suggests scouting on foot; its real sense is an opening statement.

clue.text: Extremity warrants a gratuitous donation

definitions.meaning: the end point of something
a small sum given to a waiter, a gratuity

explanation.definitionFit: An end point of something, and a gratuity given for service.

clue.text: South East North African river which is very old

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south
E is the compass abbreviation for east
the Nile flows through Egypt and Sudan

explanation.surface: Points of the compass and an African river describe an ancient place.
explanation.definitionFit: Senile describes the mental decline of extreme old age.

clue.text: The Cockney chap's munched garlic maybe!

definitions.text: The Cockney chap's munched garlic maybe!

parts.words: The Cockney chap's munched garlic maybe!
parts.note: a Cockney drops the h; the phrase also means avoided, as one might garlic

explanation.definitionFit: To avoid something deliberately, as many avoid garlic; Cockney 'he has chewed' sounds the same.
